architecture.mechanism: Vibration signatures from both healthy and faulty main journal bearings
architecture.intervention: Mount tri-axial accelerometers on main journal bearing housings to continuously capture vibration signatures under diverse climatic and operating conditions, enabling timely mechanical replacement of degraded bearings before catastrophic failure occurs
architecture.expected_effect: Catastrophic bearing failure is prevented by detecting early mechanical degradation through vibration-based diagnostics, allowing bearing replacement before total failure
architecture.falsification_test: If vibration signatures captured by accelerometers on bearing housings do not reliably distinguish between healthy and faulty main journal bearings across varying temperature, humidity, and engine speed conditions, the mechanism fails
